rule: CROSS_FAMILY_CANDIDATE requires TRAIN->DEV sign persistence, concentration gate, family sign consistency >=0.8, and finite feature-target association in at least two election families. Otherwise a stable candidate is WITHIN_FAMILY_STABLE.
reason: A consistency ratio computed from only one supported family must not be described as cross-family portability evidence.
selection_effect: This changes only the descriptive portability label; it does not alter shortlist membership, model features or hyperparameter selection.
